title: Reliability Testing of Medical Model Performance under Distributed Deployment
abstract: arXiv:2609.36525v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Distributed inference has become an indispensable part of deploying medical models under practical latency, memory, and throughput constraints. Although modern frameworks improve serving efficiency through tensor parallelism, mixed precision, kernel fusion, and multi-device communication, they are generally assumed to preserve the behavior observed during centralized HuggingFace evaluation. This assumption creates an evaluation-deployment mismatch: a model may pass offline evaluation but produce a different output after the execution stack changes. To address this mismatch, we propose a testing framework and an improved, distributed-execution-sensitive medical-model benchmark that evaluates the same checkpoint and input under a centralized HuggingFace reference and matched distributed deployments. translated_title: 分布式部署下医疗模型性能的可靠性测试
translated_abstract: 在实际的延迟、内存和吞吐量约束下，分布式推理已成为部署医疗模型不可或缺的一部分。尽管现代框架通过张量并行、混合精度、内核融合和多设备通信提升了服务效率，但人们通常假设这些框架能够保持集中式 HuggingFace 评估中所观察到的模型行为。这一假设造成了评估与部署之间的不匹配：模型可能通过离线评估，但在执行栈发生变化后却产生不同的输出。为了解决这种不匹配问题，我们提出了一个测试框架以及一个改进的、对分布式执行敏感的医疗模型基准，该基准在集中式 HuggingFace 参考实现和与之匹配的分布式部署下评估相同的模型检查点和输入。在语言、视觉和多模态医疗模型上开展的大量实验表明，执行环境的变化会导致可测量的输出不一致（摘要原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文针对模型通过离线评估但分布式部署后输出可能改变的问题，提出了一个测试框架和对分布式执行敏感的医疗模型基准，通过在集中式与匹配的分布式部署下评估相同检查点和输入，揭示并量化了执行栈变化所导致的医疗模型输出不一致现象。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a testing framework and a distributed-execution-sensitive medical-model benchmark that evaluates identical checkpoints and inputs under a centralized HuggingFace reference and matched distributed deployments, revealing and quantifying measurable output discrepancies caused by changes in the execution stack.
